title: 'You need to apologise': Ben Stokes breaks silence on nightclub controversy
summary: England captain Ben Stokes said he apologised to teammates after he and Gus Atkinson missed the second Test for breaching the team's midnight curfew. Stokes admitted the nightclub controversy overshadowed the debuts of several young players and affected the squad.
